configuration.pharo.pathToVM.description: The Pharo VM used to run the Pharo image hosting the Pharo Language Server. Set an executable path or a command available on PATH (for example, pharo). Choose a VM compatible with the selected image.
configuration.pharo.pathToImage.descript: The Pharo image that can run the Pharo Language Server (https://github.com/badetitou/Pharo-LanguageServer).
configuration.pharo.imageWorkspace.descr: Expose pharoImage:/ as a workspace folder so extensions supporting virtual workspaces (for example AI assistants) can read classes from the running image.
configuration.pharo.headless.description: Whether the Pharo image should run in headless mode.
configuration.pharo.debug.onUnhandledErr: When a process of the image stops on an unhandled error, shows a notification first.
What to do when a process of the image stops on an unhandled error (playground, test, MCP call).
configuration.pharo.debugMode.descriptio: Run the image in debug mode (cannot be used in headless mode).
configuration.pharo.mcp.enabled.descript: Start the MCP server of evref-BL/MCP in the image, so that agents (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) work on the same image. Applies when the language server restarts.
configuration.pharo.critiques.enabled.de: Show the critiques of Renraku (the code critics of Pharo) on entity editors and Tonel files, in the Problems panel, with their quick fixes and the action to ignore a rule. They are computed when a document opens or is saved, not while typing.
configuration.pharo.quickInstall.imageNa: The image to download by default when using the install command.
configuration.pharo.quickInstall.serverV: The server version to install by default.
The VM version required by default for the selected server.
debuggers.pharodb.launch.program.descrip: Absolute path to a text file.
Id of the process of the image that stopped on an exception, as announced by the language server.

viewsWelcome.pharoChest.contents:
[Chest](https://github.com/pharo-spec/Chest) keeps objects by name, to use them again from the playground, the inspector and the debugger. It is not loaded in this image.
[Copy the Script that Loads Chest](command:pharo.chest.copyLoadScript)
Evaluate it in a playground, then refresh this view.
